import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:artificer_core/artificer_core.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/json.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/protocols.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/transport.dart';
import 'package:dart_mappable/dart_mappable.dart';

void verifyPersistence() {
  initializeArtificerCoreMappers();
  initializeArtificerCoreMappers();
  final parts = <OutputPart>[
    const TextOutputPart(
      'text',
      citations: [
        Citation(
          data: {
            'unknown': [1, true],
          },
          url: 'https://example.test',
        ),
      ],
    ),
    const ReasoningOutputPart(summary: 'summary'),
    const RefusalOutputPart(text: 'refusal'),
    const OpaqueOutputPart(providerId: 'fixture', api: 'api', data: {'signature': 'base64'}),
    const ProviderToolPart(
      id: 'pending',
      name: 'search',
      owner: ToolExecutionOwner.provider,
      status: ToolStatus.pending,
      native: {'phase': 'pending'},
    ),
    for (final arguments in <ToolArguments>[
      const JsonToolArguments(
        value: {
          'nested': [null, true, 3],
        },
        original: '{"nested":[null,true,3]}',
      ),
      const FreeFormToolArguments(text: 'script'),
      const NativeToolArguments(providerId: 'fixture', api: 'api', value: {'action': 'run'}),
      const MalformedToolArguments(original: '{', issue: 'incomplete'),
    ])
      ToolCallPart(callId: 'call-${arguments.runtimeType}', name: 'lookup', arguments: arguments),
  ];
  final message = AssistantMessage(
    parts,
    replay: ProviderReplay(
      providerId: 'fixture',
      api: 'api',
      modelId: 'model',
      items: [
        {'id': 'r', 'phase': 'final', 'signature': 'base64'},
      ],
    ),
  );
  roundTrip(message.toJson(), (s) => Message.fromJson(s).toJson());
  final polymorphic = MapperContainer.globals.fromMap<Message>(message.toMap());
  if (polymorphic is! AssistantMessage || polymorphic.replay == null)
    throw StateError('nested replay decode');
  for (final choice in <ToolChoice>[
    const AutoToolChoice(),
    const NoToolChoice(),
    const RequiredToolChoice(),
    NamedToolChoice(name: 'lookup'),
  ]) {
    roundTrip(choice.toJson(), (s) => ToolChoice.fromJson(s).toJson());
  }
  for (final output in <OutputFormat>[
    const TextOutput(),
    const JsonObjectOutput(),
    JsonSchemaOutput(name: 'answer', schema: {'type': 'object'}),
  ]) {
    roundTrip(output.toJson(), (s) => OutputFormat.fromJson(s).toJson());
  }
  for (final content in <ToolResultContent>[
    const JsonToolResultContent(value: null),
    const TextToolResultContent(parts: ['one', 'two']),
    const NativeToolResultContent(providerId: 'fixture', api: 'api', value: {'status': 'done'}),
  ]) {
    for (final result in <ToolResult>[
      ToolSuccess(callId: 'call', content: content),
      ToolFailure(callId: 'call', content: content),
    ]) {
      final toolMessage = ToolMessage([result]);
      roundTrip(toolMessage.toJson(), (s) => Message.fromJson(s).toJson());
    }
  }
  final native = NativePayload(
    providerId: 'fixture',
    api: 'api',
    modelId: 'model',
    data: {
      'unknown': {
        'nested': [true],
      },
    },
    unknownEvents: [
      {'type': 'future', 'payload': null},
    ],
  );
  final result = GenerationResult(
    message: message,
    finishReason: FinishReason.paused,
    native: native,
    usage: const Usage(inputTokens: 1),
  );
  final events = <GenerationEvent>[
    const GenerationStarted(responseId: 'response', requestId: 'request'),
    const PartStarted(id: 'p', index: 0, kind: GenerationPartKind.text),
    const PartDelta(
      id: 'p',
      delta: TextDelta(text: 't'),
    ),
    const PartDelta(
      id: 'r',
      delta: ReasoningDelta(text: 's'),
    ),
    const PartDelta(
      id: 'c',
      delta: ToolArgumentsDelta(text: '{'),
    ),
    const PartFinished(id: 'p', part: TextOutputPart('text')),
    const UsageUpdated(usage: Usage(inputTokens: 1, outputTokens: 2)),
    const ProviderEvent(
      providerId: 'fixture',
      api: 'api',
      event: 'future',
      data: {
        'unknown': [null],
      },
    ),
    GenerationFinished(result),
  ];
  for (final event in events) {
    roundTrip(event.toJson(), (s) => GenerationEvent.fromJson(s).toJson());
  }
  for (final error in <AiError>[
    const InvalidRequestError('invalid'),
    const UnsupportedFeatureError('unsupported', feature: 'audio'),
    const ProviderError(
      'native',
      code: 'future_code',
      details: {'nested': []},
      requestId: 'id',
      retryAfter: '120',
      partialOutput: {'text': 'partial'},
    ),
    const TransportError('disconnect', deliveryState: DeliveryState.mayHaveReachedProvider),
    const ProtocolError('malformed', partialOutput: {'text': 'partial'}),
    const ResponseLimitError('large', limit: 1),
    const ClientClosedError(),
  ]) {
    roundTrip(error.toJson(), (s) => AiError.fromJson(s).toJson());
  }
  final options = GenerationOptions(
    maxOutputTokens: const Setting.clear(),
    temperature: const Setting.set(0.2),
    stop: const Setting.inherit(),
  );
  roundTrip(options.toJson(), (s) => GenerationOptions.fromJson(s).toJson());
  final embeddingOptions = EmbeddingOptions(
    user: const Setting.set('user'),
    extraBody: const Setting.set({'neutral': true}),
  );
  roundTrip(embeddingOptions.toJson(), (s) => EmbeddingOptions.fromJson(s).toJson());
  final embeddingRequest = EmbeddingRequest(
    items: [const EmbeddingInput.text('hello')],
    dimensions: 2,
  );
  roundTrip(embeddingRequest.toJson(), (s) => EmbeddingRequest.fromJson(s).toJson());
  final capabilities = ModelCapabilities({ModelCapability.tools: CapabilitySupport.unknown});
  roundTrip(capabilities.toJson(), (s) => ModelCapabilities.fromJson(s).toJson());
  const embeddings = EmbeddingCapabilities(dimensions: CapabilitySupport.supported);
  roundTrip(embeddings.toJson(), (s) => EmbeddingCapabilities.fromJson(s).toJson());
  for (final field in <NativeField<String>>[
    NativeField.omitted(),
    NativeField.present(null),
    NativeField.present('value'),
  ]) {
    roundTrip(field.toJson(), (s) => NativeField.fromJson<String>(s).toJson());
  }
  const frame = SseEvent(data: '{}', event: 'future', id: 'id', retry: 100);
  roundTrip(frame.toJson(), (s) => SseEvent.fromJson(s).toJson());
  const invocation = InvocationContext(operationId: 'op', attemptId: 'attempt');
  roundTrip(invocation.toJson(), (s) => InvocationContext.fromJson(s).toJson());
  JsonValues.validate(native.data);
}

void roundTrip(String original, String Function(String) restore) {
  if (jsonEncode(jsonDecode(original)) != jsonEncode(jsonDecode(restore(original))))
    throw StateError('persistence changed data');
}
